# website-build-skill

> A skill pack that turns your AI into an expert website builder. It teaches your LLM or agent current, researched practice in design, brand, accessibility, performance, search, security, stacks and code, so the sites it builds look and work like a professional made them.

Generated from skills/website-build-skill/manifest.json. Repository: https://github.com/aunysillyme/website-build-skill.

## Start here

- [Quick start](README.md#quick-start): run `npx website-build-skill` or paste the starter into your AI
- [Installer](docs/INSTALLER.md): headless setup, destinations, receipts, exit codes and uninstall
- [Compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): host setup routes and the evidence for each
- [Documentation](docs/README.md): method, tips, provenance and evaluation

TEAM: one command installs the seven workers' files; you open each session yourself and carry the handoffs between them. Researcher goes first.
